title: Events & Services — the site as it is today

callouts.text: Service times, typed in here by hand. They now match the home page exactly, because both come from the same place — and they are cross-checked against the ChurchTrac calendar automatically.
The dead Live Streaming link again.
The calendar. It says October 2026 — No events to display. This is the single thing the survey complained about most.
Everything else on one endless page, with St Nicholas Day 2023 still at the top of it. Now four pages: Calendar, Visitors, Recent Events and Bulletins.
